title: Developmental Milestones to Watch (and When to Seek Help)
summary: Most children develop at their own pace, but there are signs that deserve professional attention: clear difficulty in speech that is hard to understand, challenges in focus, social interaction, or noticeable motor delays compared to peers. Early observation and intervention make a big difference—do not wait 'until they grow out of it.'
try_this: This week: Observe your child’s development in speech, movement, and interaction. Note anything that concerns you to discuss with the doctor.
reflection_prompts: Is there a developmental aspect that worries you?
Have you discussed it with the pediatrician?
